DBG Desk browser CPU mode — third-party software and corresponding source

Unicorn.js 2.1.4, GPL-2.0
  Binding source commit: 560284c59c11c8d6c94d537f4354339f069ddcdf
  https://github.com/AlexAltea/unicorn.js
  Engine source commit: 8028ec436f2d9376525352dd38ed9ed6b9f6be10
  https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn
  Licenses: /vendor/unicorn-LICENSE.txt and /vendor/unicorn-core-COPYING.txt
  Exact source archives available from this same site:
    /vendor/sources/unicorn-js-2.1.4.tar.gz
    /vendor/sources/unicorn-core.tar.gz
  To build: extract both archives, place the core tree at unicorn/ inside the
  binding tree, install the Emscripten SDK, Python and CMake, then run
  python3 build.py x86 as described in the binding README. No engine patches.
  Copyright notices and authors are retained in the source archives.

  Core commit: 022575848782a4801fd150fdbc927effcbca0864
  Licenses: /vendor/capstone-LICENSE.txt and /vendor/capstone-core-LICENSE.txt
